page.overview:
Who is Coleet?

Coleet was a human female who served as a spy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. She was a Rebel mole inside the Arrth-Eno Prison Complex and joined fellow spy Eneb Ray in a plot to kill Darth Sidious, the ruler of the Galactic Empire. The plot failed and Coleet, along with every Rebel spy on Coruscant except for Ray, was killed when the Empire destroyed Arrth-Eno to kill the spies along with a group of imprisoned opposing senators and, at the same time, score a propaganda victory against the Rebellion by pinning the explosion on them.
